Definition: from G575 and G154; to demand back:--ask again, require.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus tells His disciples to give to every man that asks, and says the rich man's soul shall be required of him that night. The word is the demanding back, the claim laid on what was given.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for demanding back carries no teaching of its own; its warning is the rich fool's, that the soul lent to us will one day be required.
